blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – No Filipinos were harmed in the recent protests in France and Italy, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said Monday morning. “Per the latest reports from the Philippine Embassy in Paris and the Philippine Consulate General in Milan, no Filipinos have been reported to be involved or harmed in the protests,” DFA spokesperson Analyn Ratonel said in a text message to reporters. Over the weekend, nationwide protests erupted in France over the rising cost of living. The demonstrations later descended into what French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu described as “violence of extreme intensity.” READ: France counts cost of […]...
